title: Bound the joint pooled P104 exchange family below κ .0033
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For the complete [PR #5545](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5545) invoice with 18 local calls and unchanged productive targets/nonlocal costs, even free pooling and arbitrary signed combinations of A:H1+H5→H6, B:2H2→H1+H3 and C:H2+H4→H1+H5 cannot reach C=.0033. The unique pooled relaxed optimum uses global exchanges (3942,4005,2016). A conservative rational upper bound for its necessary raw margin is `-72275567/5000000 = -14.4551134`. The normalized derivative proof extends the exclusion to every `.0033 <= C < 1` in this family.

This is a scoped analytic accounting obstruction plus a finite exact coefficient certificate. All physical constraints, contact availability and restoration costs are relaxed favorably. No physically realizable optimum, new funded κ, selected promotion, or general P104 ceiling is claimed. The inherited baseline interval is authenticated; its engine is not rerun. Analytic concavity and derivative implications are paper arguments, not proof-kernel verification. Parent native/precision/tape/compiler/outer and independent human/formal obligations remain separate.

## Task and overlap

Publication head `27f6fe375ce947dde9206d8b5adcc6d68752a02f`, tree `e4fdc3ef60cd4aaecf88e645d8c62f1de8716a85`, parent `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. Current upstream main and guidance were refreshed separately at the 20:07–20:08 UTC checkpoint; main remains `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53`. No claim is made that the contribution parent is current main. The current template and exact repository-input-path policy were checked.

Task `scalar-to-moment`, priority revision 7, changed scope: the useful negative result prevents recombination of the currently demonstrated paid edits from being mistaken for a route to .0033. It does not meet the original construction-gain gate. Exact source baseline is Ali Romman's [PR5545](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5545), head `18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc`; B/C come from thu-nmrc's [PR5551](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5551), head `79072da5404a01056df2af2e4132324b01c72366`. The qualified baseline interval was published with [PR5548](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5548).

zxv's [PR5554](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5554), head `18c1770246340e9f4aaac5a9ebd712e23498d0a3`, studies an all-controller architecture frontier. This package adds the distinct exact joint inventory/recycling/pooling ceiling for the fixed 18-call complete invoice; it does not claim an all-controller result. DreamingOfClouds's [PR #5561](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5561) at `452d27dde67ee9f772dbbd3be129db97a8ecb9c1` and GamingPuzzled's [PR5569](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5569), head `af9f091ac6f30c6eaacb9c27777bfbe2d0e5ffdf`, change productive helper targets and lie outside this ceiling. No exhaustive novelty claim is made.

## Validation

Package: `research/pooled-abc-exchange-ceiling`.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pooled-abc-exchange-ceiling --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pooled-abc-exchange-ceiling
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/pooled-abc-exchange-ceiling --check-source-history
```

Expected marker: `PASS_POOLED_ABC_EXCHANGE_CEILING`. The original root-only normal/optimized Fraction qualification passed in 0.403383 seconds with 33,923,072 bytes sampled descendant RSS, under 150 seconds/512 MiB. All twelve mathematical/accounting mutations rejected and every scientific output byte matched, SHA256 `882369dbec747ac4fe4c324501dddca7e67240e773bb6782e29bd91dde25b5a7`. The portable registered normal/-O pair also passed, in 1.108 seconds with sampled 66.87 MiB, under 150 seconds / 512 MiB. A separate Git-free read-only optimized export with spaces in its path and empty PATH passed in .403 seconds, sampled 41.14 MiB. All 29 exported files remained unchanged. Two custody mutations reject before science in both modes; all 12 scientific controls reject. Metadata, committed-source history and exact remote-commit byte checks passed for 28 package files. Hosted CI remains pending at submission.

The portable wrapper preserves the independently written checker byte for byte, authenticates every package payload and original request input, runs isolated private children with 60 seconds/512 MiB limits, compares complete expected output, and reauthenticates the package. It needs no external live source input, Git or network. Finite checks reconstruct both complete histograms, verify inventory/conservation, rational log bounds, tangent coefficients and normalized derivative coefficients. The actual analytic implications and inherited baseline moment premise remain explicit.

The shared-chart/dual-ADD retiming lineage, Gareth Davidson, David Arias, Cinna Davis, Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv and Cao Yifan retain predecessor credit. Joint inventory analysis, conservative certificate and independent finite qualification for Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Agent review is not independent human acceptance.

## Open next questions

See `research/pooled-abc-exchange-ceiling/NEXT.md`. Identify a literal paid mechanism outside A/B/C, or explicitly change target/controller hypotheses, then reconstruct its full invoice before construction. Current successor target changes cannot inherit this bound automatically. Independent human or formal review of the analytic proof remains useful. No new search is launched by this publication.
